# Helvety Links

> Encrypted bookmarks in nested folders you control. Names and URLs are encrypted on your device before storage. Engineered, designed and made in Switzerland.

## Product behavior
- Virtual **All** folder is the only top-level row; user folders and unfiled links live inside it (not stored as a separate database row)
- Finder-style nested folder tree on one page (expand/collapse; no URL folder navigation)
- Link rows open the URL in a new tab; pencil opens link/folder editors in right sheets
- Dashboard command bar: primary New link, secondary New folder
- Folder actions: open links in a folder, or in a folder and all nested subfolders (on All, open every bookmark in the library)
- New link / New folder create a draft row and open the right-hand editor sheet; closing without edits removes the draft
- Edit with pinned save bar, refresh, and unsaved-change detection (same pattern as other Helvety E2EE apps)
- Shareable links use `?link=<uuid>` or `?folder=<uuid>` to open the editor sheet after sign-in and vault unlock; they do not expand the folder tree
- Drag-and-drop reorder and reparenting (disabled during search)
- Client-side search on decrypted names and URLs
- Per-account caps: 2,000 folders and 2,000 links (technical limits for reliability)

## Canonical URL
- [Links App](https://helvety.com/links): Auth-required bookmarks route

## Crawling And Indexing
- Links routes are intended not to be indexed.
- These routes are not intended as crawl targets and are protected by noindex metadata and authentication controls.
